coordinate_system.rule: All points are author landmarks, never approved spawn tiles. Bounds are search aids; use individual source rectangles, not their bounding box.

counting.unit: Concurrent people per settlement per facet, not spawners or lifetime population.
counting.rule: Named NPCs occupy listed slots and are not additional people. Bank and healer slots are separate from vendors even though both derive from BaseVendor. Guards exclude enemies and residents. No town-wide total is a density measurement.
counting.facets: Counts apply independently on each facet. Shared cast labels are mirror proposals, never shared serials, crime records, quest state or travel permissions.
counting.stock: Stock town values are minimum service targets, not replacement totals or additive spawn instructions. S9 retains other valid stock specialists; S7 owns Haven and its existing cast.

implementation.services: Use existing Server.Mobiles vendor, Banker and Healer types with their normal stock inventories and eligibility. A name or job title does not implement a quest.
implementation.residents: Resident and quest actor type null means a proposed non-vendor actor requiring later implementation. Do not spawn abstract bases or invent class names. Do not use Peasant as an inert resident: it derives from BaseEscortable.
implementation.guards: Guard counts are staffing proposals, with type null pending the P608 physical guard implementation and qualification. Stock WarriorGuard and ArcherGuard are law-enforcement mobiles with relocation and reinforcement behavior, not generic garrison actors. Do not repurpose them for hired enemies. No new guard mode or law change is authorized.
implementation.law: S3 and S13 own jurisdiction polygons and facet law. Preserve current stock enforcement until each physical patrol jurisdiction qualifies. Fort sentries are garrison staffing, not permission to extend a town guard zone over a quest encounter. Buccaneer's Den stays unguarded.
implementation.names: New names are draft placement labels. P672 people keep their identity and original quest role; distant contacts post notices instead of cloning the giver.
implementation.release: S10 may place service NPCs before quests exist. Quest interactions and encounters remain deferred. S18 owns custom dungeon actors and openings; S14/S19 own fenced land. Candidate travel routes grant nothing until a separate approved build.
implementation.stock_reconciliation: For each service type, count retained S9/S7 occupants on the facet and fill only a shortfall. Named stock-town proposals name an existing matching slot only if no authored identity is displaced.
